records.title: [課題|かだい][理解|りかい] — Task
records.body: Listen to the conversation and decide what the person has to do next.

records.title: ポイント[理解|りかい] — Key point
records.body: Hear the question first, then listen past the distractors for the real reason or detail.

records.title: [概要|がいよう][理解|りかい] — Gist
records.body: Listen to the whole talk; the question comes at the end. Choose the speaker's main point.

records.title: [即時|そくじ][応答|おうとう] — Quick response
records.body: Listen to the short line and choose the best reply.

records.title: [統合|とうごう][理解|りかい] — Integrated listening
records.body: Several speakers weigh options. Track what is ruled out and what everyone agrees on.
